note: Cases mirror validate_groupby_enum_column_gap (types/config_type.rs): the hidden enum values of a groupByField/columns pair, with paired controls for each early exit. Expectations are the compiler's findings on the same program (orb validate --json). Entities are named Task (not Card) to avoid the unrelated UI-name collision error.

findings.message: Board buckets Task rows by 'status' into columns [todo, doing, done], but the field's enum also allows [cancelled] — rows with those values match no column and silently disappear
findings.suggestion: add a column entry for each missing key (cancelled) or narrow the Task.status enum
